spans.title: My Beloved Violin
spans.blurb: Locked in years of bondage, a man tells what one violin gave him: friends, rest, comfort at midnight, and the wildest dancing in Louisiana starlight.

spans.title: The Niece of Cinna
spans.blurb: Surrounded on a dark Roman road by three swaggering men of rank, a young woman has only her name, her nerve, and one loyal slave beside her.

spans.title: A Summons by Moonlight
spans.blurb: A secret note calls a young Roman to a moonlit temple where a veiled woman waits. She offers him everything; he wants only to see her face.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals who the veiled woman at the temple is and that she becomes the hero's secret enemy, a discovery the book stages through the mysterious summons.

books.pairNote: Different characters and different nights; neither scene touches the other's payoff.

spans.title: First Night at the Wheel
spans.blurb: His pilot falls sick, the raftsmen want Stillwater tonight, and a boy of nineteen takes the wheel just as lightning rolls down the lake.

spans.title: The Balcony Scene
spans.blurb: Hidden in a dark orchard, a young man hears the girl above confess her love to the night air. He answers, though being found means death.

spans.title: The Robbler's Feather
spans.blurb: On a Tyrol mountain path, a feather worn the wrong way in a hat means a challenge to fight. A girl hurries to explain before fists fly.

spans.title: The Battered Hat
spans.blurb: Two men examine a shabby black hat a stranger left behind. One sees nothing; the other reads the owner's whole fortunes from its brim.

spans.title: The Bar of Gold
spans.blurb: A doctor is pulled from his fireside to fetch a friend home from an opium den by the docks. Among the smoke, an old man plucks his sleeve.

books.pairNote: Two entirely separate cases with no shared text or shared reveals.

spans.title: Two Horses in Step
spans.blurb: Two riders pace down an avenue of elms at sunset, horses perfectly in step, neither speaking. He will call it the one moment he truly lived.

spans.title: The Man in Lincoln Green
spans.blurb: A lord's kinsman spoils a village May dance and calls for a farmer's ears. Then a stranger in green leaps from the inn window, staff in hand.

spans.title: The Forbidden Loan
spans.blurb: A librarian looks up at a bent, goatish giant asking to borrow a dreadful old book, and weighs what refusing such a visitor might cost.
spans.spoilerNote: States outright that the visitor is barely human and hints his mother met a dark end, points the book unveils gradually.

spans.title: The Prints in the Road
spans.blurb: Dogs bark all night in a hill country village. By morning there are round prints in the road, big as barrel heads, and the party line hums with panic.
spans.spoilerNote: Mentions in passing that Wilbur has died and that something was reared in the sealed house, developments the book stages before this point.

books.pairNote: Separate episodes; the story span notes in passing a death that follows the short's scene, but neither contains the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Runaway Freighter
spans.blurb: From a station promenade, watchers follow a doomed freighter circling Earth like a runaway moon, waiting for the flare that will end it.
